diagnosis: The check C4 passed in all rollouts because the lone decision-maker used the public fact S2, which indicates that the performance format is 'live'. This fact is derived from the rights-holder confirmation (PF1), which is owned by A2 and flips check C4. Since the decision-maker had access to S2, they were able to satisfy C4 without needing the hidden information from PF1.

C4.why: The rights-holder confirmation changes the plan from ordinary performance with optional recording to a purchased live-performance license and a recording prohibition.
